# langsmith_deployment_revision (Data Source)

Reads a deployment revision.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_deployment_revision" "example" {
  deployment_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  revision_id   = "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment_id` (String) Deployment ID.
- `revision_id` (String) Revision ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Revision creation time.
- `id` (String) Revision ID.
- `source` (String) Revision source.
- `source_revision_config` (Attributes) Source configuration for the revision. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source_revision_config))
- `status` (String) Revision status.
- `status_message` (String) Revision status detail.
- `updated_at` (String) Revision last update time.

<a id="nestedatt--source_revision_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source_revision_config`

Read-Only:

- `deepagents_version` (String)
- `image_uri` (String)
- `langgraph_config_path` (String)
- `repo_commit_sha` (String)
- `repo_ref` (String)
- `source_tarball_path` (String)
- `tracked_packages` (List of String)
